findings.highlight: The only ones here are his worms
findings.evidenceJa: 手足となる蟲だけだった
findings.governingReading: Only worms serving as Zouken’s hands and feet were ever present in the house.
findings.explanation: The English retains the worms but omits their role as extensions of Zouken’s body and agency.

findings.evidenceJa: 時間を浪費してしまった
findings.governingReading: Shirou recognizes that giving himself over to anger caused him to waste time.
findings.explanation: The English adds that the unspecified loss was “too much,” intensifying its measured extent.

findings.evidenceJa: 桜とイリヤが顔を合わせる前に
findings.governingReading: Shirou must return before Sakura and Illya come face to face.
findings.explanation: The English recasts a mutual encounter as Sakura locating Illya, adding pursuit and discovery.
